1.consolidated_definition: Lanzarse el tiro o la patada con las espuelas, al unísono, los dos gallos contendientes, tras la picada de uno de ellos a su rival. Caguas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To launch the spur or kick with spurs, in unison, the two competing roosters, after one of them has pecked at its rival, Caguas-style.
